newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzanian shilling firm on dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Tanzanian shilling firm on dollar and pound.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling, which has been depreciating for the last month, firmed against the dollar and pound ahead of tax reforms expected in the 1997/98 budget, the Central Bank of Tanzania and industry analysts said on Monday.
The shilling exchanged at a commercial mean rate of 624.7593 compared to Friday's 625.1850. Against the pound, the shilling exchanged at a mean of 1019.2980 from 1020.9303.
Financial analysts said the Tanzanian government was expected to restructure the country's tax system in an effort to simplify it.
"The government's announcement of the tax reforms has had a positive effect on the market and erased a lot of nervousness. It's generally expected to be more investor friendly," an analyst said.
The budget is scheduled for June 19.
